questions.passage: I insisted—and I still think this today—that I had an interesting life. ‘Meaningful’ isn’t something I understand.”
questions.prompt: What does Kahneman's remark about not understanding 'meaningful' express?
questions.promptZh: Kahneman 说不理解 meaningful，表达什么？
options: A claim that every person is unable to understand any word about life.
A finding that his life was objectively meaningless by every possible measure.
A new definition in which meaningful and interesting must always mean the same thing.
His own difficulty with that description, while he insists that his life was interesting.
optionsZh: 声称每个人都无法理解任何人生词语。
发现其人生在所有可能指标上客观无意义。
新定义：meaningful与interesting必须永远同义。
他本人不理解这一描述，同时坚持自己人生有趣。
analyses: A isn’t something I understand 的I限定本人，非全体。
B 对词与描述的不认同，不是所有指标的客观无意义证明。
C 前句坚持 interesting，与meaningful形成区别，不是宣告必同义。
D 将本人的理解困难与前句坚持的标签一并保留，且不把today挪为网站当前日期。

vocabulary.meaning: 理解；领会某概念的意义
vocabulary.context: 在此针对meaningful这一人生描述，不是缺乏所有认知理解能力。
vocabulary.example: He could describe his life as interesting without claiming to understand that other label.
